title: Medicare Benefit Coordination for Customers Holding Two Insulin Pharmacy Programs
content:
For a customer of the Insulin and Injection Supply Pharmacy Program holding both permitted programs — the Insulin Pharmacy Medicare Part B Pump Insulin Program and an Insulin Pharmacy Medicare Part D Program or Insulin Pharmacy Medicare Advantage Prescription Drug Program — each item is dispensed on exactly one of them.

## Coordination rules

1. **Which program dispenses which item.** J1817 pump insulin is dispensed only on the Part B pump insulin program, and every other insulin, pen needle and syringe only on the Part D or MA-PD program, where the tier's backup supplies term allows backup pens or vials.
2. **Separate administration.** Each program keeps its own prescription authorization, refill timing and cost share.
3. **Separate caps.** The Medicare monthly cap applies to each program separately; one program's payments never count toward the other's cap.
4. **Consolidated shipper.** Refills of the two programs whose earliest ship dates fall within the shipment consolidation period in calendar days of each other ship together in one insulated shipper on the later date.
5. **Expedited fee.** An expedited fee the customer requests for that shipper is charged once, on the Part D or MA-PD program.

## Item placement

| Item | Program it is dispensed on |
|---|---|
| J1817 pump insulin | Part B pump insulin program only |
| Any other insulin (vials or pens) | Part D or MA-PD program only |
| Pen needles | Part D or MA-PD program only |
| Syringes | Part D or MA-PD program only |

## Consolidation, worked through (hypothetical figures)

With a consolidation period of 7 calendar days:

| Earliest ship date, Part B pump insulin refill | Earliest ship date, Part D or MA-PD refill | Days apart | Outcome |
|---|---|---|---|
| 2026-05-04 | 2026-05-09 | 5 | Ship together in one insulated shipper on 2026-05-09, the later date |

If the customer requests expedited shipping for the combined shipper, the expedited fee is charged once, on the Part D or MA-PD program.
